Welcome to Castle Arch Hotel
Accommodation in Meath
Welcome to The Castle Arch Hotel - Tucked away in the heart of the picturesque heritage town of Trim just 35 minutes from Dublin the Castle Arch Hotel is the perfect mix of old-world charm, cosy luxury, and modern-day magic. Whether you're planning a weekend escape, a wedding celebration, a family break, or just looking for a base to explore the rich history and beauty of Meath, you'll feel right at home here.
Our award-winning three-star boutique hotel has long been a favourite for those who love a laid-back atmosphere without compromising on quality. With just 21 spacious, en-suite bedrooms, each room is designed with comfort and tranquillity in mind ideal for couples, friends, and families alike. We offer family-oriented services and adventure packages to nearby attractions, making it a great spot for memory-making getaways.
From romantic castle views to riverside strolls, and local legends to vibrant pubs, Trim is full of stories waiting to be discovered and Castle Arch Hotel is right in the middle of it all. Whether you're here to explore or simply relax and recharge, we'll help you do it in comfort and style.
If you're getting married, we'd be honoured to host your big day. Our newly renovated ballroom sets the perfect scene for weddings, civil ceremonies, and all kinds of special occasions. With a warm and experienced team to guide you through every detail, your day will feel effortlessly special and totally stress-free.
When it comes to food, we believe you shouldn't have to leave the building to enjoy some of the best dining in Meath. Our guests rave about our fresh, flavourful menus and welcoming vibe. Whether it's a hearty dinner with the family, a casual lunch, or a celebratory meal, you'll find delicious options and friendly faces throughout.
Trim is one of Ireland's most treasured heritage towns, and when you stay at the Castle Arch Hotel, you're perfectly placed to explore it all from Trim Castle and the River Boyne to vibrant local shops and charming cafes. It's the kind of place where stories are shared over coffee, laughter fills the air at celebrations, and every guest is welcomed like an old friend.
So whether you're celebrating a milestone, escaping the city, planning a family trip, or saying "I do", the Castle Arch Hotel offers the charm, character, and comfort you're looking for.
We are pleased to be a 2022 Gold Medal winner of the Virgin Media Gold Medal Awards, under Ireland's 3 Star Hotels.
